'''Stage IV Beckons''' are a type of [[Mobs|Mob]], placed in the [[:Category:Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] Tier.

They are one of the [[Bosses]] of the Mod and will grant players the {{AdvancementLink|I am a monument to all your sins}} if they are present. Killing one will also grant the {{AdvancementLink|Eradicator}}.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns after a [[Stage III Beckon]] evolves, but not if there's a [[Parasite Biome#Node|Node]] or another [[Stage IV Beckon]] nearby.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Stage IV Beckons are Stationary Biome Catalysts and Block Infesters, as well as Defensive Support Parasites.

*Stage IV Beckons are capable of spawning [[Stage I Beckon|lower]] [[Stage II Beckon|Stage]] [[Stage III Beckon|Beckons]]. [[Stage IV Beckon#Summoning and Mobs Value|More info below]].
*Stage IV Beckons are capable of instantaneously evolve any Parasite below the [[Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] Tier, ignoring the [[Evolution System]]. This Ability is accompanied by a nondamaging lightning strike. The following transformations are possible:
**Any [[Assimilated Mobs]]<ref>Except for the [[Assimilated Ender Dragon]]</ref> or [[:Category:Walking Heads|Walking Head]] will be turned into a [[Primitive Parasite]].
**Any [[Primitive Parasites|Primitive Parasites]] will be turned into their [[Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] form.
*Starting from [[Ubiquitous Development]] Level 4, Stage IV Beckons will be able to generate a [[Parasite Biome#Node|Node]], which will subsequently generate a [[Parasite Biome]].
*Stage IV Beckons throw 8 bombs around them when damaged, this has a cooldown of 5 seconds. These bombs inflict 20 damage each and place an effect cloud of [[Viral]] and Poison.
*Stage IV Beckons can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 18, with a 20-tick cooldown and 5 Blocks range.
*When the weather is a thunderstorm, a vortex will appear above the Stage IV Beckon that can throw around non-parasite mobs and players. The player may use [[Venkrol Anchor Boots]] to protect themselves from this.
* Upon death, if at least one [[Colony]] is present in the dimension, Stage IV Beckons will become [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].

=== ''Summoning'' ===
Stage IV Beckons are capable of spawning lower Stages Beckons around the target. Unlike other Beckon Stages, Stage IV Beckons do not use [[Biomass]] to summon.

The summoning Ability is based on Points. Each Mob has a certain Points value. Spawned Parasites will either be sorted by Ground type or Air, Parasites categorized as Air type will be spawned instead of Grounded if the target is 3 blocks above the summoner.

'''Stage IV Beckons have a total of 12 Points per summon and can summon 4 mobs before its cooldown of 8 seconds with a cap of 12 parasites active at once.'''

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Stage IV Beckons, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
*The large green Biomass bulb on top of the Stage IV Beckon functions as a Weak Point. When this Weak Point is hit, damage inflicted to it is tripled and the [[Bleeding]] Effect is applied to it.
*Stage IV Beckons will take damage over time and die if the current dimension is at [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] or lower.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Like all Nexuses, Stage IV Beckons do not despawn by default.
*While previous Beckon stages are signaled by a church bell tolling, the Stage IV is signaled by a prolonged pipe organ chord.
*Beckons are known as '''Venkrol''' internally. The etymology or meaning of this is unknown.
*It has been confirmed that Beckons will have more growth stages in the future. In fact, there is a texture for a Stage V Beckon present in the mod files, though it's currently only a texture map. 
*Despite their floral shape, Beckons and Dispatchers are not related to plants, as they're the same kind of pseudo-arthropod as Inborns and Pures. Additionally, Beckons' biomass pods are not eggs, though they serve a similar function.
*While the previous Beckon stages have roots on the bottom of their models, the Stage IV lacks them. Its unknown if this is intentional.
*The advancement associated with the Stage IV Beckon, '''"I am a monument to all of your sins"''' is a direct reference to the Gravemind from the Halo franchise.
